thread:
Ops Bot: PAGER P1 — GPU capacity exhaustion detected in prod-east-1 (cluster inference-prod-1). Queue length > 900 for 12m. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/r/gpu-capacity

Sam (oncall): I'm taking this. graphs show queue spike to ~3k requests, tail latency spiking. Who's on infra?

Anita (infra): infra oncall here. checked ASGs and spot pools; spot nodes healthy but cluster-autoscaler logs show repeated iam:PassRole failures starting ~03:22 UTC. suspect role scoping change from recent deploy.

Lee (sre): grabbing autoscaler logs now. snippet:
```
E2026-04-12T03:25:11Z aws_cloud_provider.go:999] FailedCreate: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole denied for arn:aws:iam::12345:role/Redwood-GPU-NodeRole
```

Maya (eng): we pushed a launch-template tag update at 03:15 to include build-id; the pipeline also updated some ASG tags. could be LT tag drift.

Deploybot: Deploy recorded: launch-template v4 -> v5 at 03:15 UTC. Note: a subset of ASGs still report lt=v4.

Julian (cloud): mitigation suggestions: 1) scale reserved GPU pool (dedicated) 2) relax taints on prewarm nodepool 3) route traffic to lower-memory model variant. Recommend 1 + 2 for fastest recovery.

Sam (oncall): Anita, can you scale reserved capacity? also please diff the IAM policy from this morning.

Anita (infra): opening manual scale request: reserved-gpu-prod +6 nodes (p3 equiv). initiating IAM policy rollback to restore iam:PassRole to cluster-autoscaler role.

Lee (sre): autoscaler still attempting scale but also logging LT mismatch errors:
```
I2026-04-12T03:28:02Z scale_up.go:250] Scale-up triggered for nodegroup gpu-nodes-prod need 10
E2026-04-12T03:28:03Z launchtemplate.go:210] launch template tag mismatch: ASG tag lt=v4 != expected lt=v5
```

Sam (oncall): roll back launch template tags to v4 on affected ASGs. Anita, do it in small batches to avoid churn.

Anita (infra): rolling back ASG tags to lt=v4 on 3 ASGs now. IAM patch applied. waiting for instances to come up.

Ops Bot: Metric update: inference_queue_length dropped from 3200 -> 1100 after reserved nodes began booting. 5xx rate peaked at 18% and is now 5%.

Customer Bridge: customers reported errors on embeddings and chat endpoints 03:20-03:40 UTC. notified top customers and opened bridge.

Lee (sre): current pending pods: ~220. pending reasons: Insufficient gpu (majority) and Taints/nodeAffinity (some). several pods pinned with nodeSelector gpu-type:V100 which we lack free capacity for. suggest relaxing selectors for aged pending pods.

Sam (oncall): agreed. Lee, patch pending pods in inference-critical older than 10m to remove strict nodeSelector. limit to 40 pods.

Lee (sre): running patch (example):
```
kubectl get pods -n inference-critical --field-selector=status.phase==Pending -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.status.startTime < "2026-04-12T03:20:00Z") | .metadata.name' | xargs -I{} kubectl patch pod -n inference-critical {} -p '{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{}}}'
```
Patched 38 pods.

Julian (cloud): temporarily removed NoSchedule taint from prewarm nodes and added label prewarm=true. scheduler placed critical inference pods there.

Anita (infra): launch-template rollback complete. ASG tags consistent across groups. IAM PassRole errors stopped ~03:36 UTC.

Lee (sre): autoscaler reported successful additions: +9 nodes across gpu-nodes-prod-1/2. pods are starting to schedule. backlog decreasing.

Ops Bot: 5xx error rate down to 1.8%. queue length ~180. latency per token down to ~1.2s.

Customer Bridge: sending recovery notice to customers; bridge room created for follow-up.

Sam (oncall): preparing handoff in 20m. Lee will own follow-ups and RCA. Action items:
- Anita: full IAM policy audit and pipeline rollback gating
- Julian: automate prewarm taint relaxation as a timed mitigation for spikes
- Lee: add autoscaler alert for PassRole failures and LT tag mismatches
- Sam: update runbook to validate LT/ASG tag consistency pre-rollout

Deploybot: Incident flagged for RCA. RCA due within 24 hours.

Sam (oncall): marking incident mitigated; handoff to Lee for RCA and postmortem. thanks everyone.
